name: com.ilongda/blog
description: MCP server for Longda's Interesting World blog - provides access to blog posts, knowledge base, and content discovery capabilities via browser-side WebMCP tools
title: ilongda.com Blog MCP Server

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Return basic discovery metadata for ilongda.com.

tools.name: get_site_guide
tools.description: Fetch the agent-readable site guide from /llms.txt.

tools.name: get_full_content_archive
tools.description: Fetch the generated plain-text archive of public posts and knowledge pages.

tools.name: get_recent_feed
tools.description: Fetch the Atom feed for recent public posts.

tools.name: search_public_content
tools.description: Search the public Hexo search index for a query string.
